product.summary: Arculus self-custody cold-storage wallet combining an NFC secure-element card with the Arculus mobile app and three-factor authentication.
product.notes: Arculus first-party history states the Cold Storage Wallet launched in 2021. Current official product page lists stock, price and Buy Now controls, supporting on_sale.

events.title: AirGap Wallet v3.34.4 released
events.description: The official AirGap Wallet repository published v3.34.4 on 2026-03-26 with an Android APK and changes including a Coreum-to-TX Chain rebrand, transaction-history search, balance-loading improvements, camera-permission handling, an RSR contract update, and Kusama/Polkadot explorer fixes.

evidence.title: Arculus Cold Storage Wallet
evidence.notes: Current official product page establishes self-custody, card/app architecture, current stock and purchase availability.
